work/1.title: Kingdom Animation Trailer
work/1.subtitle: Environment Design
work/1.description:
Role: 3D Environment & Sound Artist

Responsibilities:
• Designed a large-scale, fantasy-inspired 3D library environment for an animation rendering
• Built the space around a key narrative moment, with focus on atmosphere, scale, and storytelling
• Designed all environment props and layout, from moodboard to final composition
• Created clean, optimized UV maps for high-quality texturing
• Edited the movie trailer, including video editing and sound design for cinematic tone and emotional impact
work/1.tools: Unreal Engine, Blender, Substance 3D Painter, Adobe Photoshop & Premiere Pro

work/2.subtitle: & Animation

Responsibilities:
• Created 3D character costumes and in-game assets including modeling, UV mapping, optimization, skin-weight painting, and texturing
• Contributed to 2D assets, UI visuals, and illustrations for visual consistency across 30+ mobile game levels and 100+ characters
• Played a key role in Fashion Battle production (120M+ downloads), collaborating with design, development, and production teams
• Contributed to playtests, UX feedback, and quality control

work/3.title: Boneheads Raid
work/3.subtitle: VR Game Design
work/3.description:
Role: 3D Environment & VFX Artist

Responsibilities:
• Built the environment layout for the VR combat arena
• Modeled and rigged the skeleton enemy characters
• Animated enemy attack and hit reaction sequences
• Created dynamic light and trail effects for enemy weapons
• Developed hit reaction particle effects for combat feedback in Unity
• Designed shader based spawn and death materials for enemy characters

work/4.title: Cozy Zen
work/4.subtitle: Game Design & Development
work/4.description:
Role: Game Designer & Developer

Responsibilities:
• Developed a fully playable PC game prototype as a master's thesis project after researching cozy game experiences through a winter Zen garden concept
• Programmed the full gameplay codes and interactions in Unity
• Designed a complete 3D environment with interactive buttons, letting players build their own zen garden by choosing and placing items
• Designed main character, material shaders and prop animations
work/4.tools: Unity, Blender, Substance 3D Painter, Adobe Photoshop & Premiere Pro

work/5.title: Spotify Album Canvas Design
work/5.description:
Role: Motion Designer

Responsibilities:
• Designed the visual identity for the Spotify release of hip hop album "Bulut", including album presentation and Canvas animations
• Created short-form motion visuals inspired by hip hop and street style combining video editing, motion design, and rhythm-driven storytelling
• Crafted visuals to enhance the listening experience while aligning with the album's mood and atmospheric tone
• Optimized assets for platform-specific constraints and Spotify interface integration

work/6.title: Jazz Fest Commercial Design
work/6.description:
Role: Art Director & Motion Designer

Responsibilities:
• Directed and produced a commercial motion piece for a jazz festival with rhythm-based editing, typography, and music-synced visual storytelling
• Prepared the model through makeup styling and directed a professional photoshoot for high-quality campaign visuals
• Integrated motion design with photographed material, focusing on rhythm, composition, and brand identity
• Submitted the project to a competition and received the "Mansion Award" recognition

work/7.description:

• Created social media and print assets adapted for digital platforms to ensure clarity, impact, and consistency
• Built a visual direction capturing the raw energy of the stage while maintaining a cohesive campaign identity
work/7.tools: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro & After Effects
